blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected the current front, back, left, right, three-quarter views and all six required poses. In neutral and arms-up, a central segmented pale panel is visibly exposed below the overskirt; the crouch shows strong thigh/body exposure and split cloth; sit retains exposed thigh and detached/angular rear cloth. The longer shaped-hem draft was built and simulated, but the visual result remains unacceptable. This is prototype appearance evidence only; garment ease, fit, Shape Key behavior, strain and runtime are not accepted.

Directly inspected all current views and poses. Standing skirt remains broad and irregular rather than clearly pleated. Crouch and sit show curled and angular rear/between-leg panels; prone is collapsed into a blocky sheet. Cloth simulation completed, but pose appearance is rejected.

Directly inspected all current views and poses. The collar remains a tall open cylindrical rim. Sleeves and underarm transitions are visibly faceted and heavily wrinkled, including arms-up and crossed-arm. No measured fit, clearance, strain, or runtime acceptance.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
